risk_note: RV2 (console dictionary editing; fund-term keys). Keys are classified before the guard (unknown keys count as fund terms); a request may carry one class only (mixed / empty -> 20001); the permission point follows the class: general -> config.general, fund terms -> content.fund_terms with totp, agreement -> content.agreement with totp and legal_confirmed_by; reads accept any of the three without step-up. A fund-term request refused by the guard (10403 / 10003) writes a dict_items_denied audit row before the error is rethrown (L46). Save is publish in one transaction: FOR UPDATE on the dict_version row (non-canonical value -> 50001, L47), every change checked (variables against texts.default.json, banned words) with all errors in one 20001, expected_version CAS (20902 resource=dict_item; concurrent first publishes fall back on the primary key), new dict_items version rows, dict_version + 1 with its history, audit with before / after values, fund-term flag and legal confirmer; an audit failure rolls back. Rollback writes old values as a new version and re-checks them. Banned-word and fund-term key lists are generated snapshots (content/specs, with --verify); texts.default.json is read once at runtime. No funds. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
